title: Winner detection
nl_description: The function receives a 3x3 game board. Each cell may contain 'X', 'O', or an empty string ''. The function checks whether anyone has won. A player wins if three of their symbols are placed in the same row, in the same column, or on one of the diagonals. If a winner is found, the function returns their symbol: 'X' or 'O'. If there is no winner or the game is still in progress, the function returns None.

requirements.text: Return 'X' if three 'X' form a line.
Return 'O' if three 'O' form a line.
Return None if there is no winner.
Do not modify the input board.

notes: Boundary cases: empty board, draw, two lines at once.
